content.docTitle: Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress on Adding a Law to the List of the National Laws in Annex III to the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China(Adopted on October 27, 2005)

paragraph.content: This instrument was not given a chapter number under the Legislation Publication Ordinance (Cap. 614). An unofficial reference number, however, is assigned to this instrument in Hong Kong e-Legislation (http://www.elegislation.gov.hk) for identification purposes. This also enables users to carry out a search by reference to the unofficial reference number.

This English translation is reproduced from “The Laws of the People’s Republic of China 2005” compiled by the Legislative Affairs Commission of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress of the People’s Republic of China. It is for reference only and has no legislative effect.

longTitle.content: At its 18th Meeting, the Standing Committee of the Tenth National People’s Congress decides to add a national law to the list of the national laws in Annex III to the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China, i. e. , the Law of the People's Republic of China on Judicial Immunity from Compulsory Measures Concerning the Property of Foreign Central Banks.
